description: In the same vein as The Valley, following cast members of Vanderpump Rules who outgrew the original concept of the reality series, In the City will do the same with the stars of Summer House. The new Bravo spinoff will follow Kyle Cooke, Amanda Batula, and Lindsay Hubbard into the fall season and trade the lush Hamptons coastal life for the gritty concrete jungle of NYC. Viewers will gain more insight into Hubbard’s home life as a new mother, and Cooke and Batula will continue to open up about their marriage as they balance their work lives and their desire to grow their family. The show has already been filmed in its entirety and is expected to air in the first half of 2026.
